titles.romaji: Chou Futsuu Toshi Kashiwa Densetsu R
titles.native: 超普通都市カシワ伝説R

description: A surreal gag anime about female junior high school students who along with mysterious creatures attend a junior high school set in the real Kashiwa town, together loosely conveying the charm of Kashiwa with contents related to the town and its events.
